notes.text: SALARY TABLES: 1.4.2023-31.12.2023 CCNL 16.11.2022 Tabella G (new classification in force from 1.4.2023); from 1.1.2024 and 1.1.2026 CCNL 23.2.2026 Tabella B. Monthly = annual / 12. The anticipation increments of 2022-2023 and the old categories before 1.4.2023 are not modelled.

Salary tables from CCNL Comparto Funzioni Locali 2022-2024 (ARAN, 23.02.2026). Art. 56 Tabella A (monthly increments per 13 months) and Tabella B (annual amounts per 12 months + 13th). Monthly values = Tabella B / 12.

Tranche 3 (2026-01-01) from parziale conglobamento indennità di comparto (Art. 60): Tabella B col.2 / 12. ARAN announcement explicitly states 'decorrenza retroattiva al 1/1/2026'. DATE CORRECTED 2026-09-09: was incorrectly set to 2027-01-01 in initial extraction; confirmed as 2026-01-01 via ilccnl.it (values match exactly) and ARAN press release.
Hourly divisor 156 from Art. 74 CCNL 16.11.2022 (36h/week standard working time for comparto Funzioni Locali).
13 mensilità confirmed by Art. 56 comma 1 terzo alinea ('per tredici mensilità') and Tabella A header.

Layer 2 implemented. Part-time: engine scales by part_time_pct. Fixed-term: PA is excluded from NASpI addizionale (lavoratori delle pubbliche amministrazioni in statutory exclusion list per INPS guidance); fixed_term_additional_rate=0.000 in tax file. Apprenticeship: no ARAN CCNL defines percentage or under-classification tracks; narrow high-qualification form under D.Lgs. 81/2015 Art. 47 exists for research profiles but is not operationalized in any examined CCNL.
Seniority via differenziali stipendiali (Art. 14 and Art. 78 CCNL 16.11.2022): selective procedure, not automatic — maximum_count=0.

CNEL code S105 confirmed via multiple secondary sources: kitech.it lists 'CCNL Comparto Funzioni Locali [Cnel: S105]', lavoro-economia.it concurs. Not stated in official ARAN PDF; CNEL archive not separately queried.

2025-2027 RENEWAL NOT YET MODELLED. ARAN signed an ipotesi di CCNL Funzioni Locali 2025-2027 on 21 July 2026. Retroactive increases from Jan 1, 2025. Pending comitato di settore, Governo, and Corte dei conti certification. Average monthly increase will be around €136.76 from base; exact per-level amounts not yet verified for this file. STATUS CHECKED 2026-10-17: still an ipotesi (ARAN, 21 July 2026), under verification at the Ministry of Economy and Finance before the Council of Ministers and the Corte dei conti; the ARAN president expected the definitive signature around mid-October 2026, not confirmed on 2026-10-17 (lentepubblica.it, 'Rinnovo CCNL Enti Locali 2025-2027: tra un mese la firma definitiva?'). Model the tranches and the arrears from 2025-01-01 once it is signed.

limitation.remediation: Add the 2025-2027 per-level amounts once the CCNL is certified and signed.

location.section: Art. 28 cc. 2, 4-5 (ferie)
location.quote: rispettivamente di 26 e di 30 giorni lavorativi

provenance.transformation: 28 days on a five-day week (c. 2); 26 for a worker hired for the first time in a public administration, for the first three years of service (cc. 4-5). The CCNL counts the three years in any public administration ('a qualsiasi titolo prestato' / 'presso una qualsiasi pubblica amministrazione'); the tiers read the seniority with this employer, so a worker with earlier public service gets 26 (30) days when the text gives 28 (32): state the seniority with the earlier public service included.

location.section: Art. 36 cc. 1, 11 (assenze per malattia)
location.quote: b) 90% della retribuzione di cui alla lettera "a" per i successivi 3 mesi di assenza;

provenance.note: Job kept 18 months within the three years before the day (the CCNL sums 'le assenze per malattia verificatesi nel triennio precedente' the last episode): 540 days of 30-day months over a window of 3 years; 9 months (270 days) in full, 3 (days 271-360) at 90%, 6 (days 361-540) at 50%. The window ends on the sick day, not on the start of the last episode. The cut of the accessory pay of the first 10 days (D.L. 112/2008 art. 71 c. 1) is not modelled.

reviews.scope: Whole file. The values checked were not recorded.
findings: The review recorded no list of the documents it read.

reviews.scope: Salary tables, additional months, hourly and daily divisors, overtime, leave, sickness and seniority, against the CCNL of 16 November 2022 and of 23 February 2026.
findings: The first period started on 2022-11-16, the signing date; the new classification of Tabella G applies from 1 April 2023 (art. 13 c. 1).
Overtime is in art. 32 c. 5 of the CCNL 16.11.2022, not in the CCNL 2022-2024.
Sickness: comporto of 18 months with 9 months at 100%, 3 at 90% and 6 at 50% (art. 36), not 270 days at 100%.
Leave: 26 days for the first three years of a first public employment (art. 28 cc. 4-5).
The 2025-2027 renewal is an ipotesi of 21 July 2026, not in force.

reviews.scope: Periodic review due 2026-12-31: the tabellare of 2024 and of the conglobamento of 2026 against Tabella B of the CCNL of 23 February 2026, and the status of the 2025-2027 renewal.
findings: Tabella B (p. 83): the eight annual amounts of the four areas, from 1 January 2024 and from the conglobamento, over 12 give the monthly amounts of the file (for example 24.941,67 / 12 = 2.078,47). Match.

The 2025-2027 renewal is still an ipotesi of 21 July 2026 under the checks of art. 47 D.Lgs. 165/2001 on 2026-10-17; the limitation renewal_2025_2027_missing stays open with the status recorded. The next review is moved to 2027-01-31 to model it once signed.

No verified reference case is added: it needs a provider output (a payslip or an official example) whose request the engine can state; the two Funzioni Locali payslips replayed pay individual elements (posizione, ad personam, IVC) that no request input states, so only their base salary is compared.
